resolutions.researcher_notes: youm7.com (2023-07-10, 'Inauguration of Raven field gas link project to Western Desert gas complex in Alexandria') reports Minister El-Molla presided over the 'full operational start of the first phase' on 2023-07-10 -- i.e. operating status confirmed. Independently, the official Ministry of Petroleum site (petroleum.gov.eg, 2022 year-in-review) states phase 1 of the Raven-field-to-Western-Desert-complex link was completed/operational (350 MMcf/d) as of 2021, with phase 2 (Al-Amreya butane line) commissioned Sept 2022. Egypt Oil & Gas (egyptoil-gas.com, English) independently corroborates the July 2023 inauguration event and 'full operational' framing (verified separately, not cited here to keep to the two strongest/official refs). No contradiction on status; minor nuance is phase-1 (2021) vs full-system (2023) operational milestones, both consistent with current Status=operating. Prior current_ref (same youm7 URL) had been marked DEAD_LINK in the brief but re-verified live (200, content present) -- reinstated.

Both sources explicitly state the Raven field-to-Rashid-to-Western-Desert-complex line is 70 km (30-inch diameter): youm7.com ('70 km with a 30-inch diameter... from Rashid to the gas complex'); petroleum.gov.eg official ministry page independently states the same link ('...لربط غازات حقل ريفين على مجمع غازات الصحراء الغربية...بطول 70 كم'). Note both sources also mention a separate, smaller 5 km/18-inch spur from Raven field to the Al-Amreya butane plant -- distinct from this 70 km trunk line to the Western Desert complex; not to be confused. 70.00 km value fully corroborated.

Both sources explicitly identify the pipeline's feedstock as gas from the Raven field ('غازات حقل ريفين' -- 'Raven field gases'), one of the North Alexandria concession fields developed by bp (per Egypt Oil & Gas, English, corroborating separately: 'linking Raven field...to the natural gas complex in the Western Desert'). FuelSource='Raven Field' fully corroborated by 2 independent sources.

youm7.com states the line runs '...from Rashid to the [Western Desert] gas complex' (70 km trunk). petroleum.gov.eg independently specifies the Raven field gas is produced 'في منطقة رشيد' ('in the Rashid area') and piped to the Western Desert gas complex ('مجمع غازات الصحراء الغربية'). StartLocation=Rashid and End=Western Desert complex both corroborated by 2 independent sources; no contradiction found.
